trials.title: A Study of Nemtabrutinib Plus Venetoclax vs Venetoclax + Rituximab (VR) in Second-line (2L) + Relapsed/Refractory (R/R) Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma (CLL/SLL) (MK-1026-010/BELLWAVE-010).
trials.official_title: A Phase 3, Open-label, Randomized Study to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of Nemtabrutinib (MK-1026) Plus Venetoclax Versus Venetoclax Plus Rituximab in Participants With Relapsed/Refractory Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma Following at Least 1 Prior Therapy (BELLWAVE-010)
primary_outcomes: Part 1: Number of Participants Experiencing Dose-Limiting Toxicities (DLTs)
Part 1: Number of Participants Experiencing Adverse Events (AEs)
Part 1: Number of Participants Discontinuing Study Treatment Due to AEs
Part 2: PFS per the 2018 International Workshop on Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (iwCLL) Criteria as Assessed by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)
